name: – After § 14 – Am 1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recruitment of children by organised crime
part_text: 14a. Stresses that due account must always be taken of the individual circumstances of each case, including coercion or exploitation, as well as of the seriousness of the criminal offence committed, of the level of risk posed by the offender to public safety, and of the applicable EU and national law;
